note: Domain weights reflect the skills-measured outline published on Microsoft Learn as of 2026-07-24 — the version that added the Copilot Studio agents domain. Always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam.

domains.name: Describe the business value of Microsoft Power Platform
subtopics: The value of Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, connectors, Power Pages, generative AI features, and Copilot Studio

domains.name: Manage the Microsoft Power Platform environment

Business logic options including Power Fx, and using AI to create and edit tables
Environments, the security model, privacy and accessibility, monitoring, and ALM with pipelines

domains.name: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Apps
subtopics: Canvas apps, model-driven apps, Plan designer, and code apps — capabilities and use cases
Building apps with AI, including the vibe experience

domains.name: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Automate
subtopics: Cloud and desktop flows; approvals, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, Forms, and document automation
Connector triggers and actions; using AI to create and modify flows

domains.name: Describe features and capabilities of agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio
subtopics: Agent use cases; topics, knowledge sources, tools (including MCP servers and agent flows), and publishing channels
Microsoft Agent 365, monitoring usage and adoption, and agent evaluations
